Tonight: fridge & pantry helpers

Two tools that take what you actually have — not what a recipe blog imagines you bought — and hand back dinner options. Blurb note: two lines each — what it is, why you’d flip to it tonight.

The picks

SuperCook

Type in what’s in your fridge (or just likely things: eggs, rice, frozen peas, canned tomatoes); it matches recipes you can actually make right now. Tonight use: fastest zero-plan dinner finder on this list — the “Expired / Almost would be thrown out” filter is quietly brilliant before garbage day.

The Cook’s Thesaurus

A giant, calm encyclopedia of substitutions: for nearly any food, what to swap if it’s missing, including cheaper versions. Tonight use: when the recipe calls for the one thing you don’t have — this turns “it’s ruined” into “it’s different, but it’s dinner.”
